description: Feuerwehren in Kiel is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ims.kiel.de. Overview of all main fire stations, voluntary fire brigades and cat protection facilities in the city of Kiel. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Fire brigades in Kiel" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Ortsangaben, Zivilschutz, Verwaltung, opendata, Adressen, Feuerwehr. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2025-07-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
